item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud las gzer bu nyer gcig gi gzhung
rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan brgyud kyis gzer bu nyi shu rtsa gcig pa
item.note: the end of the text (12v2) gives a short transmission lineage which is not found in the version of the text in the Íatapi†aka edition: grub chen gong ma rnams la rim kyis brgyud nas / bla ma kun 'dul la / yang ston shes rab rgyal mtshan / des sras po 'bum rje 'od kyis / bla ma kun 'dul la yang la gtug / de la bkra shis rgyal mtshan / de la rtogs ldan dbon po / yang ston rgyal mtshan gyis / des rtogs ldan dad pa shes rab / de la rims kyis brgyud nas / da lta tshul khrims shes rab bdag la'o.

item.tib: rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan brgyud las gzer bu nyi shu rtsa gcig gi gzhung
